It's not clearly incorrect behavior (no observable defect in the diff), so it fits a substantive design/scope concern rather than a bug.

adjudication.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb#perform_retrieve, when SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled? is true it directly runs `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline, then checks again for an existing TopicEmbed. This is verifiably a synchronous library-call invocation of a scheduled job’s implementation, which couples the retriever to Sidekiq job code and mixes scheduling/worker concerns into a reusable library path; extracting the feed polling into a shared service (called by both the scheduled job and TopicRetriever) would improve separation and reuse. This is an architecture/maintainability concern rather than a clear correctness defect.
